label: Build a monthly Nifty time report in Google Sheets and email it
description: At the beginning of every month at 09:00, make a Google Sheets of the previous month with headers: 'Task ID', 'Task Name', 'Start Time', 'End Time' and 'Duration (hours)'. Then fetch the total tracked time for that month from Nifty. Calculate hours for each individual nifty task and put them into the created sheets document. Finally, send an email notification with the google sheets link.

stickyNotes.content:
## Setup: Nifty project, sheet and recipient

1. Add your Nifty, Google Sheets, OpenAI and Gmail connections.
2. Pick your project in **Project ID** in **Fetch Nifty Tracked Time Report**.
3. Select the same spreadsheet in **Create Google Sheet for Report**, **Insert Task Data into Google Sheet** and **Add Total Hours Row in Google Sheet**. Each run adds a new sheet named after the month.
4. Enter the recipient in **To** in **Send Monthly Report Email**.
5. The schedule runs at 09:00 on the 1st of every month. A manual **Test** reports on the previous month too.
